in_sanskrit.name: Pujitha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Worshipped, Revered One
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pujitha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is revered and worshipped. This name is given to a girl born into a Hindu family who is believed to be a manifestation of the divine and is therefore revered and worshipped.

in_hindi.name: पूजिता
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is worshipped or honored.

in_tamil.name: Pujitha
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Worshipped, Revered One
in_tamil.long_meaning: Pujitha ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who is revered and worshipped. This name is given to a girl born into a Hindu family who is believed to be a manifestation of the divine and is therefore revered and worshipped.

in_telugu.name: Pujitha
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Worshipped, Revered One

in_marathi.name: Pujitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Worshipped, Revered One
